ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida 'SILENTKILL' PowerShell — EDR/AV process kill + shadow-copy & recovery wipe chain
ucs.description: Detects the pre-encryption preparation script Rhysida (tracked by CrowdStrike as a financially-motivated criminal cluster) runs after gaining domain admin: a single PowerShell or cmd invocation that stops a long list of vendor security services and immediately deletes Volume Shadow Copies plus disables Windows Recovery via bcdedit. This kill-then-blind-then-disable triad on one host inside seconds is signature Rhysida tradecraft and rarely co-occurs in benign admin scripts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe") (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR (Processes.process="*Stop-Process*" AND (Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*Sense*" OR Processes.process="*WinDefend*" OR Processes.process="*CrowdStrike*" OR Processes.process="*CSFalcon*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelAgent*" OR Processes.process="*CarbonBlack*" OR Processes.process="*CylanceSvc*" OR Processes.process="*ekrn*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*"))) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name _time span=5m | rename Processes.* as * | eventstats dc(eval(case(match(cmdline,"(?i)vssadmin.*delete.*shadows"),"shadow",match(cmdline,"(?i)bcdedit.*recoveryenabled.*No"),"recovery",match(cmdline,"(?i)Stop-Process|taskkill"),"avkill"))) as stage_count by host _time | where stage_count >= 2 | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend ShadowKill = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vssadmin delete shadows","vssadmin.exe delete shadows","wbadmin delete catalog","wmic shadowcopy delete","Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy")
| extend RecoveryKill = ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","recoveryenabled") or ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bcdedit","bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures")
| extend AvKill = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Stop-Process","taskkill","sc stop","net stop") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MsMpEng","Sense","WinDefend","CrowdStrike","CSFalcon","SentinelAgent","CarbonBlack","CylanceSvc","ekrn","Sophos","McAfee","TmListen")
| where ShadowKill or RecoveryKill or AvKill
| summarize StageHits = make_set(pack("shadow",ShadowKill,"recovery",RecoveryKill,"av",AvKill)), Stages = dcount_if("x", ShadowKill) + dcount_if("x", RecoveryKill) + dcount_if("x", AvKill), FirstCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine), AnyParent = any(InitiatingProcessFileName), AnyParentCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), Hits = count() by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where Stages >= 2     // SILENTKILL chains all three within seconds; >=2 catches partial runs
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Bucket = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ShadowKill = CommandLine has_any ("vssadmin delete shadows","wbadmin delete catalog","wmic shadowcopy delete","Win32_Shadowcopy")
| extend RecoveryKill = (CommandLine has "bcdedit" and CommandLine has "recoveryenabled") or (CommandLine has "bcdedit" and CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy")
| extend AvKill = (CommandLine has_any ("Stop-Process","taskkill","sc stop","net stop")) and CommandLine has_any ("MsMpEng","Sense","WinDefend","CrowdStrike","CSFalcon","SentinelAgent","CarbonBlack","CylanceSvc","ekrn","Sophos","McAfee","TmListen")
| where ShadowKill or RecoveryKill or AvKill
| summarize Stages = countif(ShadowKill) + countif(RecoveryKill) + countif(AvKill), SampleCmd = any(CommandLine), Parent = any(ParentProcessName), Hits = count() by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Bucket)
| where Stages >= 2
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) (@CommandLine:(*"vssadmin delete shadows"* OR *"wbadmin delete catalog"* OR *"Win32_Shadowcopy"*) OR (@CommandLine:*bcdedit* AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy*)) OR (@CommandLine:(*Stop-Process* OR *taskkill* OR *"sc stop"* OR *"net stop"*) AND @CommandLine:(*MsMpEng* OR *Sense* OR *WinDefend* OR *CrowdStrike* OR *CSFalcon* OR *SentinelAgent* OR *CarbonBlack* OR *CylanceSvc* OR *ekrn* OR *Sophos*))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wmic)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(vssadmin\\s+delete\\s+shadows|wbadmin\\s+delete\\s+catalog|wmic\\s+shadowcopy\\s+delete|Win32_Shadowcopy|bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\\s+No|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|(Stop-Process|taskkill|sc\\s+stop|net\\s+stop).*(MsMpEng|Sense|WinDefend|CrowdStrike|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|CarbonBlack|CylanceSvc|ekrn|Sophos|McAfee|TmListen))", field=CommandLine)
| Shadow := if(regex("(?i)(vssadmin\\s+delete\\s+shadows|wbadmin\\s+delete\\s+catalog|Win32_Shadowcopy)", field=CommandLine), then=1, else=0)
| Recovery := if(regex("(?i)bcdedit.*(recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy)", field=CommandLine), then=1, else=0)
| AvKill := if(regex("(?i)(MsMpEng|Sense|WinDefend|CrowdStrike|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|CarbonBlack|CylanceSvc|ekrn|Sophos)", field=CommandLine), then=1, else=0)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[sum(Shadow, as=ShadowHits), sum(Recovery, as=RecoveryHits), sum(AvKill, as=AvHits), count(as=Total)])
| Stages := if(ShadowHits>0, then=1, else=0) + if(RecoveryHits>0, then=1, else=0) + if(AvHits>0, then=1, else=0)
| Stages >= 2

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida ransomware deployment — '.rhysida' extension write + 'CriticalBreachDetected' ransom note drop
ucs.description: Catches the final-stage Rhysida encryptor running on a host: high-velocity file renames to the '.rhysida' extension and the drop of the actor's branded ransom note 'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf' (with .txt variants). These two file-system artifacts are unique to this operator — no other RaaS uses the same extension or note name — so a single host showing both within minutes is a confirmed Rhysida detonation, not a heuristic hit.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Filesystem.file_name) as files values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.txt") by host Filesystem.file_name span=5m | rename Filesystem.* as * | eventstats dc(eval(if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.rhysida$"),"ext",if(match(file_name,"(?i)CriticalBreachDetected\.(pdf|txt)$"),"note",null)))) as artifact_types, count(eval(match(file_name,"(?i)\.rhysida$"))) as ext_writes by host | where artifact_types >= 1 AND (ext_writes >= 20 OR match(mvjoin(files,","),"(?i)CriticalBreachDetected")) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Bucket = 5m;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend IsRhysidaExt = FileName endswith ".rhysida"
| extend IsRansomNote = FileName in~ ("CriticalBreachDetected.pdf","CriticalBreachDetected.txt")
| where IsRhysidaExt or IsRansomNote
| summarize ExtWrites = countif(IsRhysidaExt), NoteWrites = countif(IsRansomNote), SampleFile = any(FolderPath), Process = any(InitiatingProcessFileName), ProcessCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), ProcessSHA256 = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256), User = any(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Folders = dcount(FolderPath) by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, Bucket)
| where NoteWrites > 0 or ExtWrites >= 20   // either the branded note OR mass-rename burst
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Bucket = 5m;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where isnotempty(TargetFileName)
| extend IsRhysidaExt = TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida"
| extend IsRansomNote = TargetFileName in~ ("CriticalBreachDetected.pdf","CriticalBreachDetected.txt")
| where IsRhysidaExt or IsRansomNote
| summarize ExtWrites = countif(IsRhysidaExt), NoteWrites = countif(IsRansomNote), SampleFile = any(TargetFilePath), Process = any(ActingProcessName), ProcessCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine), User = any(ActorUsername), Folders = dcount(TargetFilePath) by DvcHostname, bin(TimeGenerated, Bucket)
| where NoteWrites > 0 or ExtWrites >= 20
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida Ransomware Artifact Write
id: c8e1d3a4-7b22-4f1c-9c5a-rhysida001
status: experimental
description: Detects file-system artifacts unique to the Rhysida ransomware encryptor — the .rhysida file extension and the CriticalBreachDetected.pdf/.txt ransom note.
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/17
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  ransom_extension:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.rhysida'
  ransom_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf'
      - '\CriticalBreachDetected.txt'
  condition: ransom_extension or ransom_note
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - TargetFilename
  - User
falsepositives:
  - None known. Strings are operator-unique.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*.rhysida OR *.RHYSIDA) OR @TargetFilename:(*\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf OR *\CriticalBreachDetected.txt OR *\CRITICALBREACHDETECTED.PDF OR *\CRITICALBREACHDETECTED.TXT)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| (TargetFileName=/\.rhysida$/i OR TargetFileName=/CriticalBreachDetected\.(pdf|txt)$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(as=Total), count(field=TargetFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctFiles), selectFromMin(field=@timestamp, include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId]), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| NoteHit := if(regex("(?i)CriticalBreachDetected\\.(pdf|txt)", field=TargetFileName), then=1, else=0)
| Total >= 20 OR NoteHit > 0
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
